title: DocumentDeleted (v1)
description: The document is gone: object, vectors and catalog row are removed (or being removed) by every consumer. Written by the gateway (user request) or ingest (quarantine rejection).

source.description: Only these services may write DocumentDeleted.

data.description: Only facts a consumer needs to act; nothing that can be looked up. Unknown fields tolerated (additive v1).

reason.description: Why. Consumers act the same regardless; the reason is for the audit trail.

requested_by.description: Hashed API key id of the requester, when a user asked.
